trajectory_transform.trajectory_equation: R(t,theta)=g*(t-t0)+r_lab_ICRS(t)+r_device*u_ICRS(t,theta); output coordinates are relative to the first five-turn center sample.

rectilinear_plane_model.feature_definition: PC2 of standardized 12-64-turn bandpassed five-turn DC signals; PC2 is the blue-versus-red/NIR polarization mode.

findings.negative_result: Only PC2 produced both a high-quality velocity-derived chirp fit and phase-coherent out-of-sample spatial closure. PC3-PC5 did not establish a second independent orthogonal rectilinear plane family.
